interface.shortDescription: Every personal skill in one plugin — worldview, wisdom, and the domain layers on top
interface.longDescription: Applies layered Reformed and neo-Calvinist judgment to substantive work. Worldview and wisdom run on any real task; the tiers above them — software design, Apple release prep — activate only when the work touches their domain.
